description: Reserve the advertising inventory represented by one existing reach-and-frequency prediction in the connected ad account. First read its quoted inventory and terms with soclo_ads_get_rf_prediction and obtain owner approval. This reservation writes to the advertising platform immediately; confirm is not a preview switch for this operation. Retain requestId for soclo_ads_operation_status after uncertainty. Use soclo_ads_cancel_rf_reservation to cancel an existing reservation. Full field guide: soclo://tools/soclo_ads_reserve_rf_prediction.

accountId.description: The connected ad account in Soclo.

adAccountId.description: Advertiser/ad account selected from your Soclo connection.

confirm.description: True only after owner approval of spending/deletion preview.

expectedBudgetAmount.description: Approved preview amount; changes require a new preview.

expectedBudgetType.description: Approved preview budget type: daily or lifetime.

requestId.description: Reuse this request ID for confirmation and outcome recovery.
